# NeuralNg VirtualScroller AI context

Current component maturity: beta.

Import `NeuralVirtualScroller` only from
`@neural-ng/core/virtual-scroller`; never create an NgModule.
`VirtualScrollerComponent` is a deprecated compatibility alias; never generate
it in new code.

Always provide an immutable `items` collection, a deterministic positive
`itemSize`, and the viewport's scroll-axis size through `viewportSize`. Bind the
same collection to `[neuralVirtualScrollerItem]` so Angular infers the item
template type.

Ranges are end-exclusive. `start`/`end` describe the overscanned rendered
window; `visibleStart`/`visibleEnd` describe items intersecting the viewport.
Use `lazyLoad` for server range requests and keep request-race handling in the
consumer data source.

VirtualScroller is presentation infrastructure. Do not add selection, editing,
tree expansion, or layout switching to its state. Compose those behaviors in a
consumer component. Beta requires fixed-size items; never generate variable
item heights and claim deterministic positioning.

Use `unstyled` and typed `classes` for custom visuals. Preserve region/list/
listitem semantics and `aria-posinset`/`aria-setsize` metadata.
